purpose: Modal: 50% black overlay plus a centred rounded panel, Escape closes, body scroll locked. One shared module (dialog.jsx) holds useModal (Escape, scroll lock, optional focus on open), MediaDialog (animated video/iframe dialog, portalled, scale/translate fade-in) and CardDialog (static centred card with a top-right close button).

title.description: aria-label (passed to MediaDialog as `label`; CardDialog takes `labelledBy`, the id of its title, instead)

variants.name: video
variants.description: MediaDialog with aspect-video, width min(90vw,1240px,...), video with controls, round close button top-right (VideoDialog in Customers.jsx)

variants.name: embed
variants.description: MediaDialog with an iframe demo; aspect 3/4 below md, 16/9 at md+ (DemoDialog in TourDemo.jsx)

variants.name: card
variants.description: CardDialog: static (unanimated, no portal) centred card, p-6 md:p-8, max width set by panelClassName, close button top-right without a round background; used by the app-download dialog (blog/MobileSections.jsx) and the scheduler shell (pricing/GetStartedForm.jsx)
